name: Supabase
tagline: Open-source Postgres backend platform: database, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions in one project.
description: Supabase gives every project a dedicated PostgreSQL database plus the services most apps need around it: auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs (PostgREST, pg_graphql), authentication tied to Postgres row-level security, S3-compatible file storage, realtime change broadcasts, edge functions and pgvector for AI features. Because everything is plain Postgres, you can drop to SQL, use any extension it ships, or leave with pg_dump. It has become the default backend for AI app builders like Lovable and Bolt. The free plan pauses idle projects and caps databases at 500 MB. Horizontal write scaling is not yet available; Supabase's answer is Multigres, still in alpha.

pricing.notes: Free: 2 active projects, 500 MB database, 1 GB file storage, 50k MAU, pauses after 1 week idle. Pro includes $10 compute credits; Team from $599/month.

scale.notes: One Postgres primary per project with vertical compute add-ons and read replicas in other regions; Multigres (alpha) is the planned sharding layer.

strengths: Full Postgres with superuser-like access, extensions and no lock-in
Auth, storage, realtime and APIs integrated with row-level security
Instant REST and GraphQL APIs generated from the schema
pgvector and AI tooling built in for RAG apps
Fully open source and self-hostable with Docker
weaknesses: Free projects pause after a week of inactivity and are small
No horizontal write scaling yet (Multigres is alpha)
Self-hosting the whole stack is complex compared with the hosted service
Row-level security policies are easy to get wrong, exposing data via the public API
useCases: MVPs and startups needing a complete backend quickly
AI-generated apps from Lovable, Bolt and similar builders
Mobile and web apps with auth and file uploads
Realtime collaborative features via Postgres changes
notIdealFor: Write volumes beyond a single large Postgres
Teams wanting only a bare database without platform services
